item.title: CodexManager CLI Account Tool Adds Local OpenAI-Compatible Gateway
item.description:
CodexManager CLI Account Tool Adds Local OpenAI-Compatible Gateway

A new utility called CodexManager provides account pool management for the Codex CLI and a local gateway that mimics OpenAI’s API.

🔧 Overview

  • Manages Codex CLI account pools.
  • Offers a desktop application and a browser‑based Service edition.
  • Acts as a local OpenAI‑compatible gateway for Codex CLI.

🛠️ Features

  • Supports Chinese, English, Russian, and Korean languages.
  • New installations default to Auto‑detect based on the desktop WebView or browser language.
  • Users can set a fixed language in the header or Settings; the choice is saved.
  • Unsupported or unavailable language information falls back to English.
  • Built under the author’s direction using AI: Codex (98%) and Gemini (2%).
  • Only the Windows desktop build is guaranteed; other platforms require thorough testing before reporting issues.

🌐 Language Support

Language Status
Chinese Supported
English Supported
Russian Supported
Korean Supported
Others Falls back to English

🤝 Community & Sponsorship

  • CodexManager has joined the Xuanwu Community, a Rust technical community run by the OpenAtom Foundation.
  • The project accepts sponsorship partnerships; sponsors can display their logo, introduction, and official link in the README and in‑project sponsor areas.
  • Sponsorship details (wording, placement, period, launch time) are agreed upon by both parties and must be relevant to developers or the AI tooling ecosystem.
  • Partnership contact: WeChat, Telegram, or email at 18272669457@163.com (add “Sponsorship” on WeChat).
  • Thanks to PatewayAI for sponsoring the project. PatewayAI provides official model API relay services, supports Claude and Codex series models, offers transparent billing, and an economy mode as low as 5% of standard rates. Registration grants trial credits, occasional free‑credit promotions, and up to $150 in referral rewards. Sponsor visibility includes the in‑app Sponsors page, GitHub, Gitee, AtomGit, WeChat group announcements, Telegram groups, and more.

⚠️ Usage Notes

  • The author does not provide or distribute accounts, API keys, or proxy services.
  • Users must comply with the terms of service of platforms such as OpenAI and Anthropic.
  • The software is intended for learning and development only and must not be used to circumvent rate limits or service restrictions.
